request.description:
Update an owned draft

Submitters can update only their own drafts; intake roles can update drafts they manage. Updating a draft clears its outstanding information request. The tracking reference and submitter ownership remain unchanged.

Expected documented status codes: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409
